root_cause: After the 403 false-green prevention, the original branch_archive_sweep job emitted typed per-branch artifact and nonzero exit but lacked an always-run canonical issue+Brain incident writeback observer. Thus a failed standalone job did not prove an original ONE BRAIN incident occurrence was recorded and read back.
repair: Reuse existing tools/delivery/janitor-incident-agent.mjs as an --observe-archive mode in the SAME original branch_archive_sweep job with if:always. Validate original report schema, run/SHA identity and counts, classify provider failure/missing artifact/step failure separately, append idempotent issue #5333 comment with direct GitHub readback, append existing brain_observe_failure with exact occurrence/hash readback, preserve existing artifact including observer result. Reporter failure fails same original job.
prevention_rule: NO_NATIVE_JOB_ERROR_OR_MISSING_PROOF_WITHOUT_CANONICAL_ISSUE_AND_BRAIN_OCCURRENCE_READBACK. Successful sibling jobs, failure annotation, workflow red status or uploaded artifact never substitute for the owner incident registration. Never delete unique work without exact archive tag readback. Reuse only original existing hourly schedule and writer; do not broaden token or invent provider permission.

invariants: status PARTIAL_FAILURE with original 3 HTTP403 is report-required
original clean step is not global GREEN
original observer verifies both GitHub issue comment and Brain occurrence
Brain outage is native failure, never false success
no extra workflow/cron/secrets exposure or branch deletion bypass

terminal_rule: Required+CodeQL+full BRAIN exact protected head; merge; original Janitor native postmerge archive sweep; direct issue+Brain readback of observed exception; original authorized provider tag/create and safe branch outcomes; independent portal/source truth. Any uninstrumented other agents remain coverage UNKNOWN.
